name: @pipeworx/mcp-reactome

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Reactome biological pathway database by keyword across all object types (Pathway, Reaction, Protein, Complex, etc.); returns stable IDs and display names grouped by type.

tools.name: pathway
tools.description: Full pathway record by stable id (e.g. R-HSA-68886).

tools.name: pathways_for_entity
tools.description: Pathways containing an entity, looked up by external resource id (e.g. UniProt accession).

resource.description: UniProt | ChEBI | Ensembl | NCBI | GeneCards | … (default UniProt)

entity_id.description: Identifier within the resource, e.g. "P04637" for TP53.

species.description: NCBI taxonomy id as a string (default "9606" — human).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-reactome forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the reactome pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
